svg.title: FanCtl-8 full wiring diagram
svg.desc: ESP32-C6-Pico to 8-channel opto relay board with per-input pull-ups, switched mains loads, DFPlayer Mini with speaker, and 5 V supply.
svg.text: ESP32-C6-Pico · 8-channel opto relay board · DFPlayer Mini · 5 V 2 A supply
only the pins used by this build are shown
BOOT / GP9: 3 s portal · 8 s factory reset
COM = upper pad · NO = lower pad
contacts 10 A resistive — derate for fans
L → fuse → relay COM chain · NO → load → N
PE → metal enclosure / Class I loads only
qualified electrician only — never on a breadboard
coils 5 V · opto 3.3 V · GND shared
mains adapter — AC side in mains bay

g.text: One ground symbol = one node. Power the ESP32 from USB-C or VBUS, never both.
Keep mains and 5 V/GPIO wiring physically separated; mains work by a qualified electrician.
